claims.text: Carbidopa/levodopa ER capsules (Crexont): PD in adults.
claims.quote: CREXONT is indicated for the treatment of Parkinson's disease, post-encephalitic parkinsonism, and parkinsonism that may follow carbon monoxide intoxication or manganese intoxication in adults.

claims.text: Foscarbidopa/foslevodopa (Vyalev, injection): motor fluctuations in advanced PD.
claims.quote: VYALEV is indicated for the treatment of motor fluctuations in adults with advanced Parkinson's disease (PD).
